steps.en: Install the CLI or the SDK for your language
steps.zh: 装 CLI，或按你的语言装 SDK
steps.code: curl -fsSL https://install.microsandbox.dev | sh · pip install microsandbox

steps.en: Create a sandbox from an ordinary OCI image
steps.zh: 用普通 OCI 镜像建一个沙箱

steps.en: Pulls the image, lays a copy-on-write root and boots a microVM with its own kernel
steps.zh: 拉镜像、铺一份写时复制根文件系统，启动带独立内核的 microVM

steps.en: Starts the in-guest agent that serves your exec and file calls
steps.zh: 启动 guest 内的 agent，承接你的 exec 与文件调用

steps.en: Run commands in it and stream the output back
steps.zh: 在里面跑命令，把输出流回来

steps.en: Checks each outbound packet against egress policy and substitutes real secrets on the host
steps.zh: 逐个核对出站包是否符合出口策略，并在宿主侧把占位符换成真 secret

value.en: Untrusted code runs behind a hardware boundary on your own machine — the same OCI images, no daemon and no cluster, with credentials kept on the host
value.zh: 不可信代码在你自己的机器上跑在硬件边界之后——镜像仍是 OCI，无守护进程、无集群，凭证留在宿主

sources: https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/main/README.md (install one-liners; msb run debian; macOS Apple Silicon / Linux KVM / Windows WHP requirements)

https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/main/docs/getting-started/quickstart.mdx (Sandbox.create / msb run; 'What just happened': pull image, copy-on-write filesystem, boot microVM, start guest agent; exec uses the host-guest command channel, not SSH and not the sandbox network)
https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/main/docs/sandboxes/secrets.mdx (--secret 'GITHUB_TOKEN@api.github.com'; guest holds a placeholder, real value substituted outside the guest)

https://github.com/superradcompany/microsandbox/blob/main/docs/networking/overview.mdx (host-controlled stack checks every packet against policy; default egress allows public, denies private/loopback/link-local/metadata)
